Shares a three-combatant pursuit with changing route and target choices. The Candidate instead has a Wolf pursuer, all-pair hostility, an Opportunity-Attack branch, and a Goblin target determined by nearest distance to a shared corner rather than a portcullis escape and Table-owned Cover.

materialDifferentiators: After every resolved Skeleton or Wolf movement, the Goblin must recompute and intercept whichever combatant is closer to the northeast corner; the player's route can change that target identity.

The Skeleton's first-turn Disengage-versus-other-surfaced-Action choice directly changes Wolf Opportunity-Attack eligibility, coupling action selection, route geometry, and third-party target reprioritization.

The Candidate deliberately leaves the action, route, interrupt, target, attacks, rolls, damage, and later movement unresolved, making pre-resolution route and priority handling the bounded question rather than a fixed attack or control sequence.
All-pair hostility and obstacle-free geometry isolate distance-driven interception, unlike the lantern source's Wolf/Hawk indifference and pillar-derived cover routes.

dimensions.interactionSequence: The Candidate starts with the Skeleton's first-turn Action choice, then its route; leaving without Disengage can trigger the Wolf's Opportunity Attack, while Disengage suppresses that interrupt. After each resolved movement by the Skeleton or Wolf, the Goblin reevaluates and intercepts the combatant then nearer the northeast corner. Later actions, attacks, rolls, damage, and movement remain open. four-way-crank-control-cycle has a fixed Brine/Rivet/Soot/Tangle Shove/Grapple turn order; goblin-warrior-skeleton-tracer is an open-ended two-combatant battle; lantern-intercept-pairwise-control has Hawk route/attack choices, Skeleton target triage, and Wolf approach choices; mounted-dispatch-through-flooded-orchard has carrier route, dismount, and cylinder-transfer branches; open-grid-wolf-skeleton-pursuit has prescribed Wolf/Skeleton lane redirection and Opportunity Attacks; orc-fighter-rogue-close-interception has five-combatant prism-defense end conditions; prone-target-roll-mode-distance-probe has fixed Initiative and two attacks before the Wolf; rs48h-20260824t155852z-synthetic-large-footprint-route-001 has horse departure and Goblin breakaway reaction decisions; rs48h-20260824t155852z-synthetic-total-cover-transition-001 has Skeleton One's route followed by target-eligibility reassessment; rs48h-20260824t155852z-synthetic-watchfire-rotation-retry-001 runs three rounds with attack- and distance-triggered redirects; sand-band-four-skeleton-skirmish is an adaptive adventurer-versus-Skeleton skirmish; synthetic-beacon-eight-round-defense is an eight-round breach; table-authored-shove-then-grapple is a fixed Shove-then-Grapple branch; table-authored-three-shove-cycle is exactly three stationary Shoves; table-d20-circumstance-advantage-probe-repair-retry is a Horse/Wolf chase with one modified Bite test; and two-goblins-pursue-skeleton is a Skeleton escape through a north opening and portcullis. dimensions.tacticalQuestion: The Candidate asks whether the Skeleton can use its Action and route to preserve or open distance, avoid or allow the Wolf's Opportunity Attack, and change which combatant the Goblin must intercept by changing geometry. lantern-intercept-pairwise-control asks whether the Hawk completes traversal or attacks while the Skeleton triages the Hawk and Wolf and the Wolf chooses its approach; open-grid-wolf-skeleton-pursuit asks whether the Wolf reaches its endpoint through lane changes; rs48h-20260824t155852z-synthetic-watchfire-rotation-retry asks how four actors rotate priorities based on distance and recent attacks; two-goblins-pursue-skeleton asks whether an escaping Skeleton is contained through Table-owned Cover. The Candidate's material differentiator is the geometry-driven change of the required Goblin target after each movement, coupled to the Skeleton's Disengage/OA timing.
